business_summary: Jiangsu Sihuan Bioengineering Co., Ltd., together with its subsidiaries, engages in the production and sales of biopharmaceutical products in China and internationally. The company offers Delusen and New Delusen, a human interleukin-2 for injection are immunomodulators used for the biotherapy of tumors and treatment of patients with weakened immune function; Xinlisheng, a human granulocyte colony-stimulating factor injection used to treat neutropenia caused by bone marrow transplantation, cancer chemotherapy, myelodysplastic syndrome, and aplastic anemia; and Huanerbo, a human erythropoietin injection used to treat symptoms, such as anemia caused by renal insufficiency. It is also involved in the provision of flower planting; forest and natural ecosystem management and protection; forest improvement; forestry product sales; Chinese herbal medicine planting; landscaping project construction; urban municipal greening management; scenic area management; municipal facilities management; earthwork construction; engineering management services; forest park management and design management; external contracting; project cost consulting services; and sale of metal material, agricultural and sideline product, and building and decoration material. Jiangsu Sihuan Bioengineering Co., Ltd. was founded in 1992 and is headquartered in Jiangyin, China.
